# Postkit

> Portable article components, Markdown tooling, link metadata resolvers, and framework adapters.

Postkit separates a structured publishing contract from its React, Next.js, React Router, TanStack Router, and Astro renderers.

## Get started

- [Introduction](/docs/introduction) ([Markdown](/docs-md/introduction.md)): What Postkit is, how its content contract, renderers and host application fit together, and which package to start with.
- [Installation](/docs/installation) ([Markdown](/docs-md/installation.md)): Install the Postkit packages your stack needs and check the framework, runtime, and module requirements.
- [Quick start](/docs/quick-start) ([Markdown](/docs-md/quick-start.md)): Mount the provider, render a first portable article component, and connect Markdown or MDX.

## Writing

- [MDX](/docs/mdx) ([Markdown](/docs-md/mdx.md)): Author Postkit components as JSX in MDX, and configure the code blocks that fenced Markdown renders.
- [Markdown directives](/docs/markdown-directives) ([Markdown](/docs-md/markdown-directives.md)): Author Postkit components in plain Markdown with literal-only directives and the Postkit Remark preset.
- [Validation](/docs/validation) ([Markdown](/docs-md/validation.md)): Find out what Postkit checks when a post compiles, what the errors say, and how to fix them.
- [Portable documents and feeds](/docs/portable-documents) ([Markdown](/docs-md/portable-documents.md)): Normalize HTML, Markdown, MDX, or JSON and render it through a host Chakra system.
- [Link previews and unfurling](/docs/link-previews) ([Markdown](/docs-md/link-previews.md)): Resolve URLs behind a server boundary with @postkit/unfurl and render normalized link or social metadata.

## Customizing

- [Tokens](/docs/tokens) ([Markdown](/docs-md/tokens.md)): Layer Postkit over a host Chakra system so the site's tokens, fonts, and prose rhythm drive every component.
- [Part styles](/docs/part-styles) ([Markdown](/docs-md/part-styles.md)): Restyle the named parts of Postkit components with scoped slot recipes, per-instance slot styles, or the host's Chakra recipes.

## Renderers

- [Chakra](/docs/chakra) ([Markdown](/docs-md/chakra.md)): Render Postkit components with @postkit/chakra, the Chakra UI renderer, and configure it through PostkitProvider.

## Frameworks

- [Next.js](/docs/nextjs) ([Markdown](/docs-md/nextjs.md)): Connect the Postkit component map to Next.js MDX with native next/link routing.
- [React Router](/docs/react-router) ([Markdown](/docs-md/react-router.md)): Render Postkit MDX beneath React Router with router-native internal links.
- [TanStack Router](/docs/tanstack-router) ([Markdown](/docs-md/tanstack-router.md)): Render Postkit MDX beneath TanStack Router and map portable URLs into typed routes.
- [Astro](/docs/astro) ([Markdown](/docs-md/astro.md)): Render Postkit declarations in Astro MDX with server-rendered components and selective React hydration.

## Reference

- [API reference](/docs/api-reference) ([Markdown](/docs-md/api-reference.md)): Browse generated TypeScript exports or consume the same API model as structured JSON.
- [Compatibility and environments](/docs/compatibility) ([Markdown](/docs-md/compatibility.md)): Check framework, runtime, rendering, module, and hydration support before integrating Postkit.
- [Security and trust boundaries](/docs/security) ([Markdown](/docs-md/security.md)): Keep credentials, remote fetching, embed markup, authored URLs, and host callbacks inside explicit trust boundaries.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting) ([Markdown](/docs-md/troubleshooting.md)): Diagnose provider, theme, routing, hydration, directive, and remote metadata integration issues.

## Components

### Article structure

- [Aside](/components/aside): A semantic article aside with optional emphasis.
- [Callout](/components/callout): A highlighted note, tip, warning, or caution.
- [CardGrid](/components/card-grid): A deterministic grid of related navigation cards.
- [Disclosure](/components/disclosure): Native expandable content for details and FAQs.
- [Steps](/components/steps): An ordered sequence of titled instructions.
- [Tabs](/components/tabs): Keyboard-operable switchable article panels.
- [AudienceBoundary](/components/audience-boundary): An authored audience marker with a host-controlled visibility boundary.
- [KeyTakeaway](/components/key-takeaway): A highlighted summary or list of essential points.
- [PullQuote](/components/pull-quote): A prominent quotation with optional attribution and citation.
- [Footnote](/components/footnote): A reference mark in the text: a link to its note, numbered by order of first use.
- [Footnotes](/components/footnotes): The list of notes, each with a way back to its references. Closes the article unless placed.

### Media

- [Gallery](/components/gallery): A responsive image gallery with captions and links.
- [Audio](/components/audio): An accessible audio player with an optional caption.
- [Carousel](/components/carousel): A keyboard-operable image and content carousel.
- [Figure](/components/figure): A responsive image with an optional caption and attribution.
- [Video](/components/video): A responsive HTML video player with caption support.

### Technical content

- [CodeBlock](/components/code-block): Source code rendered with Chakra CodeBlock, with adapter-driven syntax highlighting, filenames, line numbers, copying, and wrapping.
- [CodeGroup](/components/code-group): A tabbed set of alternative code examples.
- [Diff](/components/diff): A semantic unified diff with additions and deletions.
- [FileCard](/components/file-card): A descriptive file link or download.
- [FileTree](/components/file-tree): A compact, semantic repository or project tree.
- [Terminal](/components/terminal): A terminal command and its optional output.
- [Comparison](/components/comparison): An accessible feature and option comparison table.
- [Stat](/components/stat): A prominent metric with context and trend.
- [Chart](/components/chart): An accessible bar or line chart with optional data table.

### Engagement

- [Poll](/components/poll): An interactive reader poll whose submission handler is host-owned.
- [CallToAction](/components/call-to-action): A focused article callout with primary and secondary actions.
- [NewsletterSignup](/components/newsletter-signup): A provider-agnostic newsletter form connected by PostkitProvider.
- [ShareActions](/components/share-actions): Reader-initiated native, copy, email, and configured social sharing actions.

### Publishing

- [ProductCard](/components/product-card): A product or recommendation card with explicit commercial linking.
- [SponsorBlock](/components/sponsor-block): A clearly disclosed sponsor message and destination.

### Discovery

- [RelatedContent](/components/related-content): A semantic list of related articles or resources.
- [SeriesNavigation](/components/series-navigation): Previous and next navigation for a named article series.
- [AppearsOn](/components/appears-on): A provenance-aware list of destinations where the post was syndicated.
- [AuthorCard](/components/author-card): A semantic author biography with portrait and profile links.
- [LinkPreview](/components/link-preview): A portable inline link, metadata card, native media player, or isolated rich embed.
- [SocialPost](/components/social-post): A consistently styled social post card or consent-gated provider embed.

## Packages

- [@postkit/unfurl](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/unfurl): Provider-neutral link metadata resolution for Postkit
- [@postkit/chakra](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/chakra): Chakra-based React components and Markdown tooling for articles
- [@postkit/shiki](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/shiki): A lazy Shiki syntax-highlighting adapter for Postkit and Chakra CodeBlock
- [@postkit/next](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/next): Postkit MDX components and link routing for Next.js
- [@postkit/react-router](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/react-router): Postkit MDX components and link routing for React Router
- [@postkit/tanstack-router](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/tanstack-router): Postkit MDX components and link routing for TanStack Router
- [@postkit/astro](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js/tree/main/packages/astro): Postkit components and Markdown integration for Astro

## Machine-readable reference

- [Component manifest](https://unpkg.com/@postkit/chakra/component-manifest.json): Versioned component names, props, examples, runtime requirements, and renderer support.
- [TypeScript API model](/api/postkit-api.json): TypeDoc JSON generated from every public package export.
- [Full documentation context](/llms-full.txt): Guides and package documentation in one text document.
- [Documentation index](/postkit-docs.json): Structured guide metadata and content.
